readings: Join telescopes to observatories on observstation, using an inner join so telescopes without a matching observatory are dropped. Group the joined result by observatories.lunarstage, with NULL as its own group. The second column is the average of telescopes.bandusagepct. Compute it per observatory station first (ignoring NULL values), then average those station averages within the phase. The third column is the number of distinct observatory stations in that phase that have at least one matched telescope. The fourth column is that count divided by the total number of distinct matched observatory stations across all phases, i.e. stations with at least one telescope. No rounding.

The second column is the average of telescopes.bandusagepct. Compute it per observatory station first (ignoring NULL values) from the matched telescopes, then average those station averages within the phase. The third column is the number of observatory stations in the observatories table with that phase, including stations that have no telescopes. The fourth column is that count divided by the total number of rows in the observatories table across all phases. No rounding.

Join telescopes to observatories on observstation, using an inner join so telescopes without a matching observatory are dropped. Group by observatories.lunarstage, with NULL as its own group. The second column is the average of telescopes.bandusagepct. Compute it per observatory station first (ignoring NULL values), then average those station averages within the phase. The third column is the number of distinct observatory stations in that phase that have at least one matched telescope. The fourth column is that count divided by the total number of observatory stations in the whole observatories table, including stations with no telescopes. No rounding.
queries:
WITH station AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage,
       AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_band_usage,
       COUNT(*) AS station_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station) AS station_fraction
FROM station
GROUP BY lunarstage;
SELECT o.lunarstage,
       AVG(s.station_avg) AS avg_bandusage,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories o2 WHERE o2.lunarstage IS o.lunarstage) AS station_count,
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories o2 WHERE o2.lunarstage IS o.lunarstage) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories) AS station_fraction
FROM observatories o
JOIN (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
) s ON s.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.lunarstage;
SELECT lunarstage,
       AVG(station_avg) AS avg_band_usage,
       COUNT(*) AS station_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories) AS station_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT o.observstation,
         o.lunarstage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
) s
GROUP BY lunarstage;
